title: POST /commands/progress (W2)
description: Case progress reported to Management. 'pickup' and 'exit-confirmed' are distinct milestones; only 'exit-confirmed' with a position fix counts as confirmed outside the zone. Position fields are what the device reports; the server never upgrades them.

commandId.description: Stable across retries. The same ID with a different body is rejected with 409 CommandIdConflict.

expectedVersion.description: Required for every step except 'exit-confirmed', where a late field report may omit it.

node.description: Only for 'position': a confirmed demo graph node.

observedAt.description: UTC time of the observation or fix. At most 2 minutes in the future.

galileoUsed.description: The receiver reported Galileo satellites used in the fix.

osnma.description: 'simulated' until real OSNMA verification exists (task 5 Stage B).

egnos.description: 'applied' only when the receiver reports SBAS used in the fix.
